name: project_test_runner
description: Runs the Project DNA test suite using bun test. Supports filtering by file pattern, test name, bail-on-first-failure, and custom timeout. Returns structured pass/fail results with duration and error details.

parameters.filePattern: Glob pattern to match test files (e.g. 'memory-store'). If omitted, runs all tests.
parameters.testName: Substring to filter test names (passed as --test-name-pattern).
parameters.bail: If true, stop on first test failure.
parameters.verbose: If true, pass --verbose to show individual test results.

name: system_info
description: Returns current system information including platform, architecture, working directory, and available disk space.

name: hello_world
description: A simple tool that returns a greeting message with the current timestamp.

name: word_count
description: Counts words, characters, and lines in a given text string, returning structured statistics.

parameters.text: The text to analyze. Empty strings are allowed and return zero counts.

name: fibonacci
description: Computes the nth Fibonacci number (F(0)=0, F(1)=1) using an iterative algorithm with BigInt to avoid overflow, optionally returning the full sequence up to n.

parameters.n: Zero-based index of the Fibonacci number to compute (0..1000).
parameters.fullSequence: When true, also returns the entire sequence from F(0) through F(n).
